name: David Samuel

affiliations.org: Language Technology Group, University of Oslo

bio: David Samuel is a researcher in the Language Technology Group at the University of Oslo, working on language models for Norwegian and other languages. Samuel is first author of NorBench, a benchmark for Norwegian language models, and co-first author of GPT-BERT, a hybrid training approach that combines masked and causal language modeling. Samuel contributes to the NorBERT model family released by the group.
known_for: First author of NorBench Norwegian LM benchmark
Co-first author of GPT-BERT hybrid pretraining
